title: Masters' face-to-face contact with future humans at a Phoenix conference

tellings.quote: they approached me physically face to face um this individual there were two individuals present one pulls up a chair so close that his knee goes into my crotch

plain: A researcher named Mike Masters, who argues that the visitors are humans from the future, says that in 2022 at a conference hotel in Phoenix, Arizona, two such beings approached him face to face. He tells it as his own experience: one pulled a chair up so close that his knee pressed into Masters' crotch. If true, it would mean these future humans walk among us and seek people out.
